title: Judge overturns Trump policies targeting travel ban nationals
summary_en: A judge has ruled the US government acted unlawfully in barring travel ban nationals from receiving decisions on applications for changes of visa status including OPT authorisation, green cards and work permits.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: Judge overturns Trump policies targeting travel ban nationals

title: Duolingo launches new ear-scanning technology at DETcon
summary_en: The Duolingo English Test (DET) has revealed its patent-pending ear scan technology that uses the DET’s mobile app to detect hidden earbuds being used to cheat exams.
author: Nicholas Cuthbert
title_cn: Duolingo launches new ear-scanning technology at DETcon

title: IDP Australia outsources onshore visa services to Bravo Migration
summary_en: IDP Education and Bravo Migration have announced a new partnership to provide  onshore visa support for international students across Australia.
author: Nicholas Cuthbert
title_cn: IDP Australia outsources onshore visa services to Bravo Migration

title: MPs slam HOELT as debate over international students continues
summary_en: UK politicians have aired their concerns over plans to introduce a fully remote Home Office-backed English language test, suggesting the model exposes the country to a weaker immigration system.
author: Beth Kennedy
title_cn: MPs slam HOELT as debate over international students continues

title: India steps up bid to reverse brain drain with global researcher scheme
summary_en: New initiative seeks to lure Indian-origin researchers home as India looks to strengthen its research ecosystem amid concerns over brain drain and growing global competition for talent.
author: Abhishek Nair
title_cn: India steps up bid to reverse brain drain with global researcher scheme

title: Bloomsbury Institute sponsor licence suspended
summary_en: Bloomsbury Institute’s international student sponsor licence has been suspended by the Home Office.
author: Polly Nash
